title: Genie One enhancements
body:
* **Conversation outline**: Use the conversation outline along the left edge of Genie One conversations to jump between your messages. Hover over a tick in the outline to preview a message and the start of its response. See [Navigate a long conversation](/aws/en/genie-one/chat#navigate-conversation).
* **Upload skills (Public Preview)**: You can now click **Upload skills** to upload your existing skill files and folders to your skills folder in the workspace. See [Upload a skill](/aws/en/genie-one/chat#upload-skills).
* **Snippets from external tool queries (Public Preview)**: Genie Ontology now also extracts snippets from queries that [external tools](/aws/en/integrations), such as dbt, run on Databricks. These runs appear in [query history](/aws/en/sql/user/queries/query-history) alongside queries that you run in Databricks. See [Genie Ontology](/aws/en/genie/genie-ontology).
* **Remembered sign-in email in the Genie mobile app (Public Preview)**: The Genie mobile app now remembers the email address of the last user who signed in and prefills it at the next sign-in. See [Use Genie on mobile](/aws/en/genie-one/mobile).
